transform_tsfeatures: create a python module that uses TsFeatures.transform to extract all statistical and seasonal features from a time series
get_stl_features: build a script that calls TsFeatures.get_stl_features to compute trend strength, seasonality strength, and spikiness from a numpy array
get_acfpacf_features: create a function that uses TsFeatures.get_acfpacf_features to extract autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation features from time series data
get_statistics: build a python module that calls TsFeatures.get_statistics to compute mean, variance, entropy, lumpiness, and stability features
get_fourier_features: create a script that uses TsFourierFeatures.get_features to compute sine and cosine Fourier features for a given period and order
